newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thailand's Finance One MD Termchai steps down.
newsitem.headline: Thailand's Finance One MD Termchai steps down.

text.p: Thailand's Finance One Plc said on Wednesday its managing director Thermchai Phinyawat has resigned from his position, effective March 5.
Thermchai has also resigned from his posts as director of both Finance One and its unit One Holding Plc, the company said in a statement to the Stock Exchange of Thailand.
The company gave no reason for the resignation.
Thermchai, 45, one of the founding members of Finance One, played a key role in investment banking activities which helped make Finance One the country's biggest finance firm.
Before joining Finance One in 1980, Thermchai worked as a banker with a foreign bank.
Finance One, said by analysts to be hit by liquidity problems, on Friday signed an agreement to merge with medium-sized Thai Danu Bank to form a new combined entity under the name Thai Danu Bank.
The Securities and Exchange Commission said last week it was investigating transactions involving Finance One officials to see if they had violated insider trading regulations.
One Holding, an investment arm of Finance One, said earlier on Wednesday it had defaulted on a $13.5 million repayment due on two maturing bills of exchange because of a liquidity problem.

The Stock Exchange of Thailand halted trading in One Holding shares in the afternoon session on Tuesday. Finance One shares have been suspended since March 3 when news of the merger with Thai Danu first broke.
